key_catalyst: SK Hynix earnings miss triggering broad semiconductor selloff and renewed AI-spending doubts
reasoning: The SK Hynix earnings miss reignited AI-capex doubts and drove a broad, still-unstabilized semiconductor selloff (NVDA, AMD, MU, INTC extending losses intraday), the primary driver of QQQ's -1.26% intraday decline. This stacks with three hawkish Fed dissents pressuring long-duration growth names and unresolved after-hours risk from Microsoft/Meta earnings, none of which show signs of absorption. With the session closing down and multiple unresolved primary drivers, overnight risk is elevated.
